arg2 with dots yields "You can only put things into one container at a time.".
Missing container with a single object yields "What do you want to put it in?".

generic_find miss yields "You don't see a/an X here.".

Closed container yields "You'd better open it first!".

put all.X <cont> puts each matching item.
put all.X <cont> with no match yields "You don't seem to have any Xss.".
